On the assimilation of Ku-band scatterometer winds for weather analysis and forecasting

Owner exclusion (2026-10-02): Figa and Stoffelen's "On the assimilation of Ku-band scatterometer winds for weather analysis and forecasting" (doi:10.1109/36.851772) was written before QuikSCAT returned data. Its assimilation and quality-control results use NSCAT winds, with ERS comparisons; QuikSCAT is discussed as a future application, not a source of measured science results. Supporting review: var/first_science_publications/results/056.json; author manuscript: https://knmi-scatterometer-website-prd.s3-eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/publications/nscat_paper.pdf
Improved resolution backscatter measurements with the SeaWinds pencil-beam scatterometer

Calibration paper (owner call, 2026-09-09). Describes the SeaWinds pencil-beam signal-processing hardware modification (deramp processing for range discrimination) and demonstrates it on a synthetic backscatter scene; no science result. Note this is the mission CSV's first_lifetime_n10_publication and first_lifetime_n100_publication (doi:10.1109/36.823904), so both fields move on the next export.
Polarimetric scatterometry: a promising technique for improving ocean surface wind measurements from space
